request.questionText: Identify the name of the most appropriate R function to fill in the blanks below: Use the [ Select ] ["select()", "arrange()", "mutate()", "summarize()", "filter()"] function to select a subset of cases as per logical tests for variable values. The [ Select ] ["mutate()", "group_by()", "summarize()", "select()", "filter()"] function alters the structure of a data frame, allowing us to change our unit of analysis. Calculate statistics to characterize sets of values with the [ Select ] ["arrange()", "group_by()", "filter()", "mutate()", "summarize()"] function. The [ Select ] ["filter()", "group_by()", "arrange()", "summarize()", "select()"] function uses specified column headings to isolate a set of variables in a data frame.
